text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I really thought today would be the day, 
but... to think it ended like this...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what's going wrong... It feels 
like I'm stumbling down a dark road with 
no streetlights.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This is no time to be stumbling, but it's 
not something that can be resolved 
overnight either...
choice_data_list:
Even in the dark, a road is still a road. 
First, let's think about why we lost.
We've got no time to be moping around!
There's no time to be moping around!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Even on a dark path, pressing 
forward will get you somewhere. One steady 
step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Let us first find the reason behind the 
defeat. That may well become the 
streetlight that illuminates our path."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I'm really getting into the 
spirit now. Let's make sure we win next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. As always, you cheer me on with 
such a wonderful voice...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I can't just sit around moping, now can I?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's make sure we win the next 
race...!
